description.en: Here the queen of the gith has been slathered with paint, but if anything, she looks unbothered by this rude intrusion into her stern painted world.

description.en: Some will pay good money for an owlbear egg, hoping to train the monsters. Most trainers don't live very long.

description.ru: Этот полусгнивший посох весь изъеден личинками, копошащимися под поверхностью. Коснувшись его, вы испытываете невыносимую тошноту... и странное желание, будто посох взывает к таким же, как он.
description.en: Live worms wriggle beneath the crumbling surface of this half-rotten staff. Merely touching it fills you with a wave of unbearable nausea and a strange longing, as if it's calling out for its like.
